title: Scherzetto
identity: Miriam Hyde, Scherzetto, for saxophone and piano, composed 1957, about two minutes. The Wirripang product page gives a suggested AMEB Grade 6, ISMN 9790720133966, and links a one-page score sample. The preview’s saxophone part is labeled “Saxophone” without a saxophone type.

evidence.claim: Wirripang’s product page identifies Scherzetto by Miriam Hyde for saxophone and piano, about two minutes, composed 1957, with suggested AMEB Grade 6 and ISMN 9790720133966.

The linked one-page sample is a score excerpt. Its heading dedicates the work “To Clive Amadio”; the saxophone part is labeled only “Saxophone.” It shows the opening marked Allegro con brio, dotted quarter note = 132, in 6/8.
evidence.source_name: Wirripang public score sample, PDF p. 1

score_observations: The single-page opening excerpt begins at Allegro con brio, dotted quarter note = 132, in 6/8. Saxophone starts immediately at mf with eighth-note figures, duplets, slurs, occasional staccato dots, and a crescendo/diminuendo contour. The piano alternates a moving bass figure with rests and sustained chords, then has denser scalar motion beneath a sustained saxophone phrase. This is a one-page excerpt, not a full-work survey.
review_focus: Inference from the opening excerpt: review articulation consistency across slurred and detached figures and coordination with the piano’s alternating bass and chordal writing. The full score is needed to judge the complete range and demands.
collection_flag: Wirripang documents a suggested AMEB Grade 6 classification. This publisher-provided classification is not a college-year recommendation. The sample labels the part only “Saxophone,” so exact instrument type remains unspecified.

score_links.description: Public one-page score sample; opening notation visually inspected.

gaps: Only a one-page sample was inspected; complete form, written range, and demands across the full piece remain unknown.
